_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::particles#0. The rule holds — PARTICLE DYNAMIC/SPH is mandatory even for a pure bond-based PD body — but the Signal is fabricated and the quoted symptom would condemn a correct deck. Deleting the sub-section from upstream particle_sph_2d_pdbody_gravity.4C.yaml aborts with 'negative initial particle spacing!' from particle/src/interaction/4C_particle_interaction_sph.cpp line 249 before a single time step: INITIALPARTICLESPACING lives there and its default of -1 is caught at setup, so there is no 'no-force simulation' and no displacement to inspect. Meanwhile the HEALTHY baseline prints 'Number of pd_neighbor_pairs in peridynamic evaluation on this proc: 0' on 1940 of its 3001 steps, because that counter is the body-to-body contact pair list and not the bond list. The entry's remedy is confirmed exactly: cutting the SPH block to the three keys it names (KERNEL, KERNEL_SPACE_DIM, INITIALPARTICLESPACING) keeps the same 1512 initialised bonds and reproduces all ten result values with abs(diff) exactly 0.00000000000000000e+00. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: Number of initialized peridynamic bonds on this proc: 1512

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: keep the SPH sub-section in the third arm instead of deleting it. That arm then runs like the baseline, the 'negative initial particle spacing!' abort disappears, NOSPH_TIME_STEPS_RUN becomes 3001 and EXIT_NOSPH becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
